Field notes

The first frost arrived early this year, and the garden beds needed covering before the end of the week.

Seedlings started indoors in late winter were moved to the cold frame, where they will harden off for two weeks.

Next season's plan keeps the brassicas in the north bed and moves the beans beside the fence for more light.

Compost from the autumn leaves should be ready by spring if it is turned every few weeks through the winter.

The rain barrel overflowed twice in October, so a second barrel will go beside the shed before the spring rains.
